## What does this change?

Describe the change and why it's needed. Link any related issue with `Closes #123`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] UI polish
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI

## How was it verified?

- [ ] Backend: `pytest -q` passes (or N/A)
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass (or N/A)
- [ ] Frontend: `npm run lint` has no new errors (or N/A)
- [ ] Production build succeeds: `npm run build` (frontend changes only)
- [ ] Visual change described, with screenshot if more than a one-line tweak

## Checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped to one logical concern
- [ ] No secrets or credentials added
- [ ] `.env*` files are not committed
- [ ] Tests added/updated where behavior changed

## Notes for reviewers

Anything tricky, risky, or worth extra attention?
